audio_prompts.purpose: Listening model for Week 6 color, shape, line, and silhouette identification.
audio_prompts.script: Look at the four looks. Number one: This look has a cool color palette. The dress is blue and green. The silhouette is long and straight. Number two: This look is black and white. The jacket is oversized, and the pants are narrow. The look has strong contrast. Number three: This look has curved lines. The skirt is flared, and the blouse is soft pink. The look feels classic and soft. Number four: This look is bright and playful. The top is yellow, and the shorts are orange. The lines are simple.
audio_prompts.speaker_profile: One adult teacher or Fashion Design classroom instructor speaking clearly to beginner learners.
audio_prompts.accent_or_variety: Clear international English suitable for Brazilian A2 learners.
audio_prompts.voice_direction: Warm, clear, and easy to follow, with short pauses after each numbered description.
audio_prompts.suggested_openai_voice_role: Choose an available OpenAI or ChatGPT voice at generation time that sounds like a supportive classroom teacher.
